items.title: Renew Baton Rouge occupational license
items.authority: City of Baton Rouge / East Baton Rouge Parish Finance Department, Revenue Division
items.description: The occupational license renewal is due January 1 and becomes delinquent March 1, with a penalty of 5% per month up to 25% and interest of 15% per year. Electronic filings are due by the last day of February.

items.title: Obtain and renew New Orleans occupational license
items.authority: City of New Orleans Safety and Permits (zoning review) and Bureau of Revenue
items.description: Any business in Orleans Parish needs an occupational license, with zoning approval first and fees set by business type and gross sales; licenses expire December 31.
